question: How can an agent push local media files into an arkiv library and have them auto-ingested without manual file copying?
trigger: A user asks to upload / 上传 / ingest a clip into arkiv
An agent needs to add media to arkiv over HTTP rather than via MCP (which is read-only)
decision: Use POST /api/ingest/upload with a multipart 'files' field and a Bearer token (ingest_write scope)
Return 202 and let the background single-flight ingest transcribe + index the clip
Poll GET /api/stats to confirm the new row appeared
evidence: The arkiv upload endpoint implementation (routers/ingest.py) and its constraints
The arkiv compose deployment where ./media-in is mounted rw at /app/media-in
success_measure: A media file dropped locally is pushed via this skill and becomes searchable in arkiv without any manual copy or UI interaction

data_sources: local media files on the agent machine

should_trigger: add these audio files to my arkiv library
should_not_trigger: show me my arkiv library stats
delete a media item from arkiv
